    Minimal projective covers of finite-dimensional modules #

    An endomorphism of a finite-support pointwise finite-dimensional module has a uniform stable image. The induced endomorphism of that image is invertible, so a noninvertible endomorphism of a projective object exhibits a strictly smaller projective retract. Minimizing total dimension among projective presentations therefore produces a right-minimal projective epimorphism.

    Nonempty (MinimalProjectivePresentation M)

    Enough projectives imply existence of minimal projective presentations in the finite-support pointwise finite-dimensional module category.
